definitions.explanation: A restaurant that serves traditional Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {和食店|わしょくてん}で{食事|しょくじ}する。
examples.english: To dine at a Japanese restaurant.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{和食店|わしょくてん}がオープンした。
examples.english: A new Japanese restaurant opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}でも{和食店|わしょくてん}の{数|かず}が{増|ふ}えており、{日本食|にほんしょく}の{人気|にんき}の{高|たか}さがうかがえる。
examples.english: The number of Japanese restaurants is increasing overseas as well, showing the high popularity of Japanese food.

notes:
A compound of {和食|わしょく} (Japanese cuisine) and {店|てん} (shop, restaurant). {和食|わしょく} was recognized as a UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage in 2013, and the term {和食店|わしょくてん} has become increasingly common both in Japan and abroad.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和食店|わしょくてん}で{食|た}べる: to eat at a Japanese restaurant
- {高級|こうきゅう}{和食店|わしょくてん}: upscale Japanese restaurant
- {和食店|わしょくてん}を{開|ひら}く: to open a Japanese restaurant
- {人気|にんき}の{和食店|わしょくてん}: popular Japanese restaurant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日本|にほん}{料理|りょうり}{店|てん}: Japanese cuisine restaurant — more formal, essentially synonymous
- {料亭|りょうてい}: traditional Japanese restaurant — upscale establishment with private rooms and full-course meals
- {居酒屋|いざかや}: izakaya; Japanese pub — a more casual drinking establishment that also serves food
- {洋食店|ようしょくてん}: Western-style restaurant — serving Western-influenced Japanese cuisine
